title: meliosma microcarpa
intro: Meliosma microcarpa, commonly known as the Sabah meliosma, is a plant species native to Borneo, specifically in the Malaysian state of Sabah. It is known for its medicinal properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Meliosma microcarpa include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids, which may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
